'''Dorothea Ariette''' ('''Dorette''') '''Pronk''' (born 1968){{r|isni}} is a Dutch and Canadian mathematician specializing in [[category theory]] and categorical approaches to [[Differentiation (mathematics)|differentiation]]. She is a professor of mathematics at [[Dalhousie University]].{{r|profile}} As well as for her research, she is also known for her work promoting [[List of mathematics competitions|mathematics competitions]] in Canada.{{r|wright}}

==Education and career==
Pronk is originally from [[Rotterdam]].{{r|egmo}} She became a mathematics student at [[Utrecht University]] in The Netherlands, where she earned a master's degree in 1991 and completed her Ph.D. in 1995.{{r|profile}} Her doctoral dissertation, ''Groupoid Representations for Sheaves on Orbifolds'', was jointly [[Ius promovendi|promoted]] by [[Dirk van Dalen]] and [[Ieke Moerdijk]].{{r|mg}} She took a faculty position at [[Dalhousie University]] in 2000,{{r|egmo|wright}} after previously being a postdoctoral researcher there.{{r|imo98}} She is a professor of mathematics at Dalhousie.{{r|profile}}

Pronk began working in mathematics competitions as an observer for the Canadian team at the 1998 and 1999 [[International Mathematical Olympiad]]s.{{r|egmo}} She chaired Canada's committee on the IMO from 2014 to 2015, the mathematical competitions committee of the [[Canadian Mathematical Society]] beginning in 2016, and Canada's committee on the [[European Girls' Mathematical Olympiad]] since 2018. She has also served as a leader of Canada's mathematics team. At Dalhousie, she has organized a mathematics challenge club and [[Math circle]]s focused both on Nova Scotia students and on First Nations students.{{r|wright}}

==Recognition==
Pronk was the 2023 recipient of the Graham Wright Award for Distinguished Service of the Canadian Mathematical Society.{{r|wright}} In the same year she was named as a Fellow of the Canadian Mathematical Society.{{r|fcms}}

==Personal life==
Pronk was raised in a strict denomination of [[Continental Reformed Protestantism|Reformed (Calvinist) Christianity]] in the Netherlands. After resisting the call because of her strict background,{{r|praise}} she has been participating in [[Worship dance|messianic dance]] through All Nations [[Christian Reformed Church in North America|Christian Reformed Church]] in [[Halifax, Nova Scotia]] since 2002.{{r|dance|praise}}
